scope: Isolated saved CollectItem prefab fixtures, production CollectItemFieldOrder.Restore, production RefreshCanvasLayers, occlusion query/calculation, and EventSystem.RaycastAll/UGUI touch dispatch. Uses the actual CorePlayUI background/Map/Layer prefab subtree, level 30005 geometry and sprites, and RenderTexture pixel comparisons against upper-only/lower-only renders. Button-event observations do not invoke gameplay collection. Cold restore/pool/undo are isolated lifecycle fixtures, not private RestoreFromSnapshot execution. Returning snapshot serialization is a production-data-contract fixture, not a call to private SaveSnapshot or a device persistence test. No player services, saves, user scenes, or phone are modified.
